The configure script just failed because no C compiler (gcc/cc) is available in the build environment. This is recorded in memory [00000011]. Before you can compile SQLite with gcov instrumentation, you need to install build tools.

The typical approach is to install build-essential (on Debian/Ubuntu) or gcc directly. After that, you can retry the configure step with the gcov flags you've already prepared (CFLAGS="-g -O0 -fprofile-arcs -ftest-coverage" LDFLAGS="-lgcov --coverage").
</context_for_action>
